name: Mice Assemble
descriptionTemplate: Shuffle 1 {derived:Swarm Impact} that deals [Damage:Arg1] DMG X+4 times into the top of your Draw Pile. {Leap}: Additionally, shuffle 1 {Get 'em! Brown!} into the top of your Draw Pile.
lore:
A lone rat scurries in a dark corner, frail and tiny, easily driven away with a broom.
The same is true for an orphan.
Even in smallness, there is strength. When an orphan partners with a rat, they can become unstoppable.
